description: Provenance-only record of completed real-runtime passivity validation for the Experiment 3 telemetry observer.

executions.B: telemetry_observer enabled with a record-only callback

validation_design.runtime_configuration: existing enabled Live Fly v1 runtime configuration

included: MaleCNS fingerprint containing the applicable mutable neural arrays/state
state_comparison.permitted_interpretation: Under the frozen implementation and environment recorded in this artifact, enabling the telemetry observer produced no observed change in the scientific runtime trajectory across the tested 5000-physics-transition / 1000-neural-transition Live Fly v1 validation run.

clock_validation.neural_time_semantics: a sample of the physics clock every fifth transition
clock_validation.transition_correspondence: neural N corresponds to physics transition 5*N
clock_validation.matched_timestamp_requirement: matched neural and physics timestamps were required to be exactly equal

limitations: This validates the tested implementation, environment, and run window.
It does not establish biological correctness of the decoder.
It does not establish that all possible future runtime trajectories are unaffected.
The six per-leg proprioceptive RNG objects were not separately exposed as standalone state snapshots, although their sampled event consequences were included in the compared runtime trajectory.
This is not scientific Experiment 3 data.
